title: Reviving someone under pressure
target: How to bring a fallen crew mate back in R.E.P.O. using the revive item, rather than discovering too late that nobody carried one.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A revive item in the crew
Somebody who is down and reachable
Enough cover to stand still for a moment

steps.do: Decide before the run who is carrying the revive item.
steps.because: reviving is done with a carried device rather than a command (ItemReviveItem)

steps.do: Take the device to the person rather than expecting them to come to you.
steps.because: the device reaches out with hands of its own (handsParent)

steps.do: Do it in a dark room without hesitating, because the device lights itself.
steps.because: it carries spot, point and healing lights (healingLight)

steps.do: Expect the revive to affect you as well as them.
steps.because: it has a screen effect for the player doing the reviving (reviveScreenEffect)

steps.do: Do not treat it as a reason to stand and fight.
steps.because: it is a revive item rather than a weapon (ItemReviveItem)

commonMistakes: Leaving the revive item behind in the van.
Trying to revive somebody from across the room.
Reviving in the open with the monster still there.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
